newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain says 1995 domestic oil output down 1.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain says 1995 domestic oil output down 1.6 pct.

text.p: Bahrain's domestic crude oil production fell 1.6 percent in 1995 to 14.46 million barrels (39,616 barrels per day) from 14.70 million barrels in 1994, the Bahrain Monetary Agency (BMA) said.
Refined oil production rose 3.7 percent to 92.1 million barrels in 1995 from 88.8 million barrels in 1994, BMA said in an annual report.
Crude oil deliveries from Saudi Arabia rose 1.8 percent to 77.1 million barrels in 1995 from 75.7 million a year earlier, it said.
Local consumption of refined products rose slightly to 3.8 million barrels last year from 3.7 million barrels in 1994.
Bahrain a small Gulf Arab oil producer, produces around 40,000 bpd from its own fields. It now also receives the entire production of 140,000 bpd of an offshore oilfield it shares with Saudi Arabia.
Bahrain also imports around 200,000 bpd of crude oil from the kingdom for refining.
